description: Use this when the user wants to read one enrolled local home-service business and search_businesses or resolve_business already returned its id. Returns one enrolled shop as JSON: id, brand, legal_name, page, booking_url, phone when published, sms, services as id and name, hours, timezone, verification status and verify_url, and booking_rules and emergency_phone when that shop has them.

shop_id.description: Enrolled shop id from search_businesses. Examples: florida-pole-barn, florida-security-concepts, booqer-demo-shop.

name: get_business

services.description: Published services, each with id and name.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the hours and slots.

title: Get a business
